name: SESB revenue metering installation - Main Meter and Check Meter (Type 1 metering)
description: tariff/revenue metering installation with main and check meters, CT/VT and data logger Primary source: https://ecos.gov.my/sites/default/files/uploads/para/attachments/2024-01/Sabah%20Grid%20Code.pdf

specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MC4.1.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Revenue Metering shall comprise of a Main Meter to measure and record the required data and a Check Meter to validate the readings from the Main Meter as back-up metering at all Connection Points.' (value: Main Meter plus Check Meter at all Connection Points; Check Meter validates Main)

specifications.metric: maximum allowable overall error - active / reactive, Type 1 (>7.5 MW or 60 GWh per annum)
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): row 'More than 7.5MW or 60GWh per annum 0.6 1.0 ...' under 'Maximum Allowable Overall Error (±%) ... Active Reactive'.

specifications.metric: minimum component classes and burdens, Type 1 (printed table row)
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): exact printed row reproduced as value; the table layout in the fetched text does not unambiguously separate all class columns, so values are retained as printed rather than reinterpreted. (value: 0.2 CT Burden 30 VA if ../1A, 15 VA if ../5A, 0.2 VT Min Burden 100VA, 0.2 Wh Me)

specifications.unit: ±5 ppm relative to Malaysian Standard Time
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Meter Clock Error (Seconds) with Reference to Malaysian Standard Time ... ±5ppm'; MC9 adds 'The Metering Database must be set within an accuracy of ±1 second of Malaysian Standard Time'.

Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'the resolution of the energy registration of 0.5S class Meters shall be better than 0.2 % and the resolution of the energy registration of 0.2S class Meters shall be better than 0.1 %'.

specifications.metric: check metering requirement by annual energy
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.4 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Check Metering shall be applied in accordance with the following Table: 1 Larger than 60GWh Check Metering Installation; 2 Less than 60GWh Check Metering'. (value: Larger than 60GWh: Check Metering Installation; Less than 60GWh: Check Metering)

Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.4 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'A Check Metering Installation shall include the provision of a separate Metering Installation using separate current transformer cores and separate secondary windings. The accuracy of Check Metering Installation shall be the same as the Main Metering Installation.' (value: separate Metering Installation using separate current transformer cores and sepa)

Sabah Grid Code clause MC4.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): list of items each Metering Installation shall consist of. (value: Meters and data loggers; CT and VT; secure protected wiring; meter panel; commun)
Sabah Grid Code clause MC6.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'target availability of the communication link shall be 95% per annum unless otherwise agreed'.

specifications.metric: laboratory testing uncertainty, Class 0.2 CT/VT and Wh meter
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Class 0.2 CT / VT ± 0.05% Class 0.2 Wh Meters ± (0.05/cos θ)%'. (value: ±0.05% for Class 0.2 CT/VT; ±(0.05/cos θ)% for Class 0.2 Wh meters)
Table 2: "Accuracy Requirements of Type 1 Metering Installation – Annual Energy Throughput Greater Than 60GWh"; MCA.1.4 Table Type 1 "Larger than 60GWh -> Check Metering Installation"

specifications.metric: Type 1 maximum allowable overall error, active at full load
specifications.basis: Table 1: More than 7.5MW or 60GWh per annum -> Active 0.6, Reactive 1.0

specifications.metric: Type 1 maximum allowable overall error, reactive at full load
specifications.basis: Table 1: More than 7.5MW or 60GWh per annum -> Reactive 1.0
Table 1: "0.2 CT Burden 30 VA if ../1A, 15 VA if ../5A, 0.2 VT Min Burden 100VA, 0.2 Wh Meter, 0.5 VARh meter"

specifications.unit: ppm relative to Malaysian Standard Time
specifications.basis: Table 1: Meter Clock Error (Seconds) with reference to Malaysian Standard Time: ±5ppm for both metering types; MC11: "The Metering Database must be set within an accuracy of ±1 second of Malaysian Standard Time"

specifications.metric: Type 1 accuracy - unity PF active at 10% rated load
specifications.basis: Table 2 row 10% rated load, Power Factor Unity, Active 0.7%

specifications.metric: Type 1 accuracy - unity PF active at 50% and 100% rated load
specifications.basis: Table 2 rows 50% and 100% rated load, Power Factor Unity, Active 0.6%

specifications.metric: Type 1 accuracy - 0.5 lag active / reactive at 50% and 100% load
specifications.basis: Table 2: at 0.5 Lag, Active 1.0%, Reactive 0.5% for 50% and 100% rated load

MCA.1.4: Type 1 (>60GWh) requires a Check Metering Installation with separate CT cores and secondary windings; "The accuracy of Check Metering Installation shall be the same as the Main Metering Installation"; check meter accuracy "shall not exceed twice the level prescribed"
MCA.1.5: "resolution of the energy registration of 0.5S class Meters shall be better than 0.2 % and the resolution of the energy registration of 0.2S class Meters shall be better than 0.1 %"
MC6.1: "The target availability of measurement transformers and Metering Installations shall be 99% per annum and the target availability of the communication link shall be 95% per annum"
MC4(m): six (6) months on-line; thirteen (13) months in accessible format; seven (7) years in archive
Appendix 2 table: Type 1 In Laboratory CTs/VTs ±0.05%, Wh Meter ±(0.05/cos θ)%, Varh Meter ±(0.2/sin θ)%; In Field Use CTs/VTs ±0.1%, Wh Meter ±(0.1/cos θ)%, Varh Meter ±(0.3/sin θ)%
Appendix 2: CT 10 years; VT 10 years; CT Connected Meter (Electronic Type) 5 years; burden tests whenever meters tested or modifications made; maximum period between inspections 2.5 years
Note under Table 2A: "All measurements in Tables 2 and 3 are to be referred to 25degrees Celsius under Meter laboratory conditions"

Appendix 2 final table: Active Import + Reactive Import = Lagging; Active Import + Reactive Export = Leading; Active Import + Zero Reactive = Unity; Active Export + Reactive Export = Lagging; Active Export + Reactive Import = Leading; Active Export + Zero Reactive = Unity
